name: Beermoney Productivity Toolbox for WooCommerce
author: beermoneycoding

sections.description:
Beermoney Productivity Toolbox for WooCommerce is a modular collection of practical admin-side tools for real store work.

Instead of adding one large all-in-one system, Beermoney gives you a growing set of focused WooCommerce apps under one central dashboard. You can activate only the tools you need and keep the rest disabled.

The plugin is designed for store owners, administrators, and shop managers who want faster workflows for everyday maintenance tasks.

Included tools

  • Dead Product Finder – identify products with little or no sales over a configurable time period.
  • Xpress Product Editor – quickly review and edit WooCommerce product information from one screen.
  • Orphan Image Cleaner – find unused product images and help clean up your media library.
  • Stock Alert Dashboard – highlight products that need restocking attention.
  • Order Notes Viewer – make WooCommerce order notes easier to review.
  • Image ALT Generator – help maintain image ALT text for product images.
  • SKU Redirects – redirect old or alternate SKUs to the correct products.
  • Backorder Notice – improve visibility of backorder-related information.
  • Fix Order Emails – improve email image compatibility in WooCommerce order emails.
  • Order Status Editable – make order status handling more convenient.
  • Restock Off – quickly disable restock behaviour when needed.

Why Beermoney

  • Modular – enable only the apps you actually use.
  • WooCommerce-focused – built specifically for day-to-day shop administration.
  • Lightweight – no front-end advertising, tracking, or customer-facing clutter.
  • Practical – created to solve real maintenance and productivity problems.

The plugin stores its own settings in the WordPress database and works entirely inside the WordPress admin area.

WooCommerce must be installed and active.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it from the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Open the Beermoney dashboard in wp-admin and enable the apps you want to use.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. Beermoney Productivity Toolbox for WooCommerce is built for WooCommerce stores and requires WooCommerce.

Does the plugin collect personal data?

The core plugin does not collect personal data from store visitors.

Some app functions may process existing WooCommerce or WordPress data inside the site admin area, such as product data, order notes, image metadata, and plugin settings. This data remains on the site unless the site owner exports or deletes it using normal WordPress/WooCommerce workflows.

Can individual apps be enabled or disabled?

Yes. Apps can be enabled or disabled from the Beermoney dashboard.

Is this an official WooCommerce plugin?

No. Beermoney Productivity Toolbox for WooCommerce is an independent plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WooCommerce.
